# Ilja Safronovs

> R&D engineer at Giraffe360 in Riga, Latvia. Works on 3D Gaussian splatting from sparse 360° panoramas and LiDAR depth: camera poses with COLMAP (structure from motion, bundle adjustment), training with gsplat (MCMC), PyTorch and CUDA. In production: a fix for blurry windows, outdoor views and mirrors in all Giraffe360 Gaussian splat videos since June 2026, his Gaussian pruning and relocation rules (the training defaults) and the looped drone video. He mentored a junior engineer, then led three engineers on a new 3D reconstruction feature, now in production. He also built an experiment runner driven by an AI agent and an MCP server for the team task board. Studies Financial Engineering at Riga Technical University. resume.md below is the full text.
